title: Make space for your day.
headline:
Make space
for your day.
scene: Warm pale peach backdrop, strong burgundy editorial serif headline occupying upper-left. A realistically rendered unbranded cream smartphone tilts at lower-right beside a single flat white calendar card. Phone has simple clear text Today and 10:00, card has exactly MON TUE WED with three abstract colour blocks, no other microtext. One soft orange halo, gentle warm sunlight and grounded shadows. Carefully layered visual hierarchy.
